name: YMCA Camp Foskett
description_short: YMCA day camp on 114 acres beside the South Charlton Reservoir for ages 5 to 14. Campers swim and take lessons at the beach, go boating and fishing, try archery and ropes activities, cook over a fire and do crafts and sports, with a theme each week.
notes: Ages 5 to 6: $325 non member, $300 program member, $275 member. Ages 7 to 14: $300 non member, $275 program member, $250 member. CIT (age 15): $300 non member. Camp 8:00 am to 4:00 pm; drop off 8:00 to 8:30, pick up 3:30 to 4:00. Registration opened March 1, 2026.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 rates: ages 5 to 6 $325 a week non member ($300 program member, $275 member); ages 7 to 14 $300 a week non member ($275 program member, $250 member); CIT age 15 $300 non member. Camp 8:00 am to 4:00 pm. Nine themed weeks June 22 to August 21, 2026. Pack lunch with an ice pack. Financial aid for anyone who qualifies. $50 non refundable deposit per week. price_per_week is the ages 7 to 14 non member rate; session prices vary by age so are left off.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 guide: 189 Daniels Road on the South Charlton Reservoir, 114 acres; swim lessons, boating, fishing, nature classes, archery and project adventure (age limits apply), sports, arts and crafts, team building, fireside cooking. Groups by age from 5 to 14, CIT at 15. Camp Director Kris Mekal, kmekal@ymcaofcm.org; 508.765.5466. The guide's rate table is headed 2025 but matches the 2026 rates on the camp page.
